title: verdict_interpretation
description: Output of the verdict-interpreter skill. Routes the pipeline after a walk-forward backtest.

status.description: The interpreter's decision, which may differ from protocol_verdict.

criteria_summary.description: Each evaluated criterion with PASS/FAIL/UNTESTED and actual value.

primary_failure_mode.description: The single most likely explanation for strategy failure.

config_to_failure_map.description: Specific config choices linked to the primary failure.

proposed_change_dimension.description: One word identifying the dimension being changed (e.g. er_threshold, smooth_period).

hypothesis_family.description: Short label for the signal family (e.g. keltner_breakout, rsi_mean_reversion).

altitude_justification.description: One sentence citing the specific diagnostic value(s) that drove the altitude choice.

diagnostic_rule_applied.description: Which named diagnostic rule triggered the verdict (e.g. 'Rule 1: cost_drag').

root_cause.description: Improvement 01: structured causal explanation replacing free-text root_cause. Required for all non-promote verdicts.

mechanism_failure.description: The single most likely structural reason the hypothesis failed. Drives orchestrator routing.

supporting_evidence.description: Must cite specific fields from protocol_result.yaml or trade_diagnostics.json — not a restatement of the verdict. E.g.: 'forecast_return_corr=0.012 (p=0.71), all-bars IC near zero, n=8840 bars'.

confidence.description: Confidence in the mechanism_failure assignment given available evidence.

trade_attribution.description: Step 03: causal attribution of performance to entry, exit, sizing, or signal. Required when trade_diagnostics.json is available.

primary_weakness.description: The dominant performance problem identified from trade_diagnostics_summary fields.

evidence.description: Must reference specific trade_diagnostics_summary fields (e.g. exit_efficiency_median=0.12, mae_mfe_ratio_median=3.1).
